title: Aurify plugin manifest
description: Everything the client reads before installing anything. Anything not declared here is unavailable to the plugin at runtime. The enforcing validator is aurify-plugin-core::Manifest::validate; this schema mirrors it for editors and tooling and carries the cross-reference rules (slots point at declared screens, screens at declared operations) in prose only.

id.description: Stable identifier; never changes across versions.

kind.description: app: draws its own screen and integrates nowhere. plugin: writes into existing client screens and runs a program on the person's machine.

entry.description: Apps only: where the screen comes from. Plugins have no entry.

slots.description: Plugins only. Every plugin must declare an apps-card slot: it is the only place it can be removed from.

screen.description: Required for every type except message-action; must be a declared screen id.

operation.description: Required for message-action; must be a declared operation name.

icon.description: Icon name from the client's set; unknown names fall back to the kind icon.

modelOperation.description: Declared operation whose result is this screen's model.

bind.description: Path into the screen's model. Required for list, toggle and progress.

operation.description: Declared operation run when the component is activated.

item.description: For list: which item fields are the title, subtitle, and so on.

args.description: JSON Schema of the arguments; carried, not validated by the SDK.

permissions.description: Data kinds the plugin will ask for through the client's permission popup. Anything not listed cannot be asked for.

removePaths.description: Paths relative to the plugin's data directory, removed with the package.
